title: Routing
readonly: Your role can view but not change the configuration

vrfs.title: VRFs
vrfs.intro: Each VRF is an IPv4 and an IPv6 FIB table with its own table ID; `default` is table 0. Source VRF select routes packets from chosen source prefixes, arriving on chosen interfaces, in this VRF. Changes go into the candidate; commit them from the bar at the bottom.
vrfs.sourceSelectHelp: Source VRF select: a packet arriving on the interface with a source address in the prefix is routed in this VRF instead of the VRF its interface belongs to.

routes.title: Static routes
routes.intro: Static routes per VRF. Several next hops make an equal-cost multipath (ECMP) route; the weight of each next hop sets its share of the traffic. A route without next hops is a blackhole (drops matching traffic).
routes.editorHelp: Next hops are the ECMP paths: add one row per path and give each a weight (1–255). A next hop can be resolved in another VRF (address only, no interface). VRFs: {{vrfs}}.
routes.statusHelp: Installed: the prefix's best FIB source in its VRF is a static (API) route. A route shadowed by a better source for the same prefix shows as not in FIB. Read once a minute.

fib.title: FIB
fib.intro: The live forwarding table of one VRF as VPP has it, read page by page (the agent pages it, so even a million routes load one page at a time). Each entry shows its best source and its paths. Every page is a full walk of the table in VPP, so the view is read on demand: refresh it with the button; the prefix filter applies on Enter.
fib.refreshHelp: Read the FIB again (each read walks the whole table in VPP)

ping.intro: Ping from the data plane (VPP), not from the management host.
ping.limits: VPP's ping API pings from the default VRF only, without a source address or payload size, and holds VPP's API while it runs: count × interval is limited to 5 seconds.

group.vrf-static-ecmp: Source VRF select, next-hop VRF, FRR

id.title: Table ID
id.help: VPP FIB table id (0 is the default VRF)

sourceSelect.title: Source VRF select
sourceSelect.help: route packets from these source prefixes, arriving on these interfaces, in this VRF

nextHops.title: Next hops (ECMP paths)
nextHops.help: more than one = equal-cost multipath; empty only for a blackhole route

weight.title: Weight
weight.help: share of the traffic among the next hops (1–255)

vrf.title: Next-hop VRF
vrf.help: resolve the next-hop address in this VRF (default: the route's VRF)

blackhole.title: Blackhole
blackhole.help: drop matching traffic; requires no next hops

viaFrr.title: Program via FRR
viaFrr.help: FRR (staticd) programs this route instead of the agent, e.g. to redistribute it
